blade.name: Blade
blade.tagline: the one who stands in the doorway
blade.blurb: You learned the trade holding a line that other people were running from. Heavy steel, heavy armour, and a stubbornness that reads as courage from a distance.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.text: Once per encounter, when an enemy misses you, make an immediate attack against it.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: Bonus action. Heal 1d10 + your level. Once per rest.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, immediately attack another enemy in the room.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.tagline: the one who was never there
stalker.blurb: You hunt. You have always hunted. The difference between you and the thing you are hunting is that you decided which of you it was.

abilities.name: Mark
abilities.text: Free action. Mark one enemy — your attacks against it have advantage until it dies or you mark another. One mark at a time.

abilities.name: Fade
abilities.text: Action. DC 13 DEX check to vanish. While hidden your next attack deals +2d6. Attacking breaks it.

abilities.name: Trapsense
abilities.text: You automatically detect hazards before they trigger. Searches for concealed dangers succeed without a roll.

emberwright.name: Emberwright
emberwright.blurb: The fire is not a tool you picked up. It is a debt you are servicing, and every casting is a payment you cannot quite afford.

abilities.name: Cinderbolt
abilities.text: 1 Ember. Ranged attack for 2d6 + INT fire. On a crit the target burns for 1d6 at the start of each of its next two turns.

abilities.name: Emberwall
abilities.text: 2 Embers. You and your allies gain +2 AC until your next turn.

abilities.name: Detonate
abilities.text: 3 Embers. 3d6 to every enemy in the room, DEX save for half. It hits your allies too.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.tagline: the one who decides who comes back
lantern.blurb: Someone has to carry the light and someone has to decide where to point it. Both of those are the same terrible job and it is yours.

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.text: 1 Oil. Action. Heal an ally or yourself for 1d8 + your WIS modifier.

abilities.name: Warding Light
abilities.text: 1 Oil. One ally gains advantage on their next saving throw.

abilities.name: Last Breath
abilities.text: 3 Oil. When an ally would die, they drop to 1 HP instead. Never yourself. Once per character lifetime — not per rest. Lifetime.
